text:
elaine: Pushed a relnotes draft for routing + batching to GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/733. Need snippet checks, a deprecation blurb for the legacy cache integration, and a tiny known-issues note.

tom: Quick skim: dep graph still mentions `redis-prefix-cache`. That was removed in v0.9 — we should add a deprecation banner and link to the migration guide to `unified-kv-cache`.

yejin: Snippet nit: both PY and JS examples use `model: 'kestrel'`. Runtime expects `kestrel-v2` now. I can open a quick PR to patch snippets and a render test.

marvin: Support wants a one-liner about fallback routing behavior in the routing table. Proposed wording:
```
During autoscale warm-up, requests may be routed to compatible smaller variants; pin `model_variant` on Dedicated routes to avoid this.
```
Keep it single-line and point to INF-3124.

elaine: Good. Plan: (1) add deprecation box for `redis-prefix-cache` with migration link, (2) swap snippets to `kestrel-v2`, (3) paste marvin's fallback line under Known issues with INF-3124 link, (4) run linkcheck.

staging-bot: PR #733 updated by elaine — changed files: docs/relnotes/2024-08-routing-batching.md, snippets/python/kestrel_example.md. CI: linkcheck queued.

tom: Running local linkcheck: `./tools/linkcheck docs/relnotes --output=artifacts/links-relnotes.json`. Results: 3 broken anchors, 1 external redirect. I'll open a tiny PR for anchor fixes.

yejin: I'll wait for the anchor PR before pushing i18n stubs. Where should JP file live? /i18n/jp/relnotes/2024-08-routing.md?

elain e: yes, that path. If anchors slip past cutoff we ship EN and follow with JP patch.

marvin: Known-issue wording (final):
Known issue: autoscale routing fallback
- Symptom: brief routing to fallback variants during cold starts under high concurrency
- Mitigation: pin `model_variant` or increase warm-pool size for Dedicated routes
- Tracking: INF-3124

elaine: Perfect. I'll add that verbatim and the deprecation row for the cache. Tom, please paste anchor list into your PR description so I can vend redirects if needed.

tom: PR #734 opened for anchor fixes. Description includes broken anchors + suggested redirects. CI flaky test but re-run queued.

staging-bot: PR #734 merged by tom — linkcheck green on staging.

yejin: Opening JP stub PR now (will wait 30m after staging green).

elain e: Final pre-publish checklist:
- [x] Deprecation note for `redis-prefix-cache` added
- [x] Snippets updated to `kestrel-v2` (PY/JS)
- [x] Known-issue blurb added (INF-3124)
- [x] Linkcheck green on staging
- [ ] JP localization PR pending (yejin)

marvin: If JP misses the window we ship EN and backfill JP the next day. Notifying translations and CS channels.

elain e: Thanks all — I'll schedule the docs publish and put the announcement copy here for review before sending. :rocket:
